Adds multi-year backlog; meaningful vs 2025 net sales of €138.6M.
Long revenue tail; limits near-term P&L impact but supports visibility.
Project milestones are long-dated; delays would shift revenue timing.
High-value, integrated systems may support margins and follow-on work.
Upside optionality if exercised; not included in initial €40M.

This is an early-stage win in a long-cycle rail program, extending Teleste’s order visibility but with revenue largely post-2028. A larger catalyst would be confirmation of option conversions, added maintenance revenues, or disclosure of margin impacts and cash flow timing.
